newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Construction Holdings to set FRN.
newsitem.headline: China Construction Holdings to set FRN.

text.p: The following issue was announced by arranger KorAm Bank on Monday.
BORROWER CHINA CONSTRUCTION HOLDINGS
AMOUNT US$30 MLN COUPON 6ML+200 BP MATURITY 3 YRS
TYPE FRN ISS PRICE PAR LAUNCH WK JAN 6
PUTS NONE CALLS NONE REPLIES 20.JAN.96
LISTING NONE REPAYMENT BULLET DENOMS US$500K
RATING NONE SALE LMTS STANDARD TAX PROV --
NEG PLG YES CRS DEF YES FORCE MAJ YES
HOME CTRY S.KOREA GOV LAW ENGLISH PAY DATE 17.FEB.96
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
LEAD MGRS US$6 MLN + 75 BP ALL-IN 225 BP
CO-LEAD MGRS US$4-5 MLN 60 BP ALL-IN 220 BP
MANAGERS US$2-3 MLN 45 BP ALL-IN 215 BP
NOTES *GOLD RAM INTERNATIONAL GROUP, A WHOLLY OWNED
SUBSIDIARY OF CHINA'S MINSTRY OF CONSTRUCTION, OWNS
43.4 PERCENT OF THE ISSUER.
**CHINA'S MINISTRY OF CONSTRUCTION WILL ISSUE A
LETTER OF UNDERTAKING TO SUPPORT THE ISSUE.
SHAREHOLDING OF THE ISSUER BY DIRECT SUBSIDIARY OF
MINISTRY OF CONSTRUCTION WILL BE MAINTAINED AT THE
LEVEL OF AT LEAST 40 PERCENT. CONSTRUCTION MINISTRY
WILL SUPERVISE THE ISSUER IN CONDUCTING BUSINESS TO
INSURE THE ISSUER'S OBLIGATION UNDER THE ISSUE WILL
BE FULFILLED ON TIME.
ARRANGERS KORAM BANK AND BA ASIA
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2847 4039
